## Migration Result
Branch: support/R1-403-poetry-to-uv
MR URL: https://github.com/torchbox/rca-wagtail-2019/pull/1210
Outcome: success
Notes: Converted pyproject.toml to PEP 621 (hatchling build backend, tilde specifiers reformatted to ~=MAJOR.MINOR.0, wagtail-orderable fork moved to [tool.uv.sources]); moved gunicorn (Poetry's only extras-only dependency, not handled by the transformer) to [project.optional-dependencies] by hand; rewrote the Dockerfile to install uv as a pinned binary image and use uv sync --locked --extra gunicorn; replaced the poetry pre-commit hooks with uv-pre-commit; updated the GitHub Actions test/lint workflows (Gr1N/setup-poetry → astral-sh/setup-uv), docker-compose.yml, README.md, and the Poetry commands/narrative in docs/upgrading.md (including re-capturing the tablib CVE hold's evidence line against a real uv lock run, since its old evidence cited a now-dead poetry update command). Verified uv.lock resolves identical versions to the prior poetry.lock for every spot-checked package (Django, Wagtail, psycopg2, redis, sentry-sdk, boto3, pillow, cryptography, lxml, urllib3, whitenoise); docker image builds clean; manage.py check/makemigrations --check and a sample test run are green; flake8/isort/black resolve correctly in the dev-stage container. Self-review clean on both axes. CI independently confirmed green (lint-front-end, lint-python, test/python-tests all pass at head a25811a39f46996cc7c2a11a360a7e5fbddf8fe9; deploy_staging/deploy_production correctly skip off a Draft PR branch). One manual-review item in the MR description: gunicorn's move to project.optional-dependencies was a hand fix since the transformer doesn't carry Poetry extras over — worth a second look even though the Dockerfile/compose already pass --extra gunicorn correctly.

## Migration Result
Branch: support/R1-403-black-to-ruff
MR URL: https://github.com/torchbox/rca-wagtail-2019/pull/1211
Outcome: success
Notes: Removed black/flake8/isort from pyproject.toml and added the canonical ruff config (line-length kept at 88 to match the project's actual [tool.black] setting rather than flake8's looser 120 ceiling, documented inline); migrated setup.cfg's [flake8] section and deleted .isort.cfg; preserved the project's custom Django/Wagtail isort import groups via ruff's section-order/sections settings (caught in self-review — dropping them would have been a real, avoidable behaviour loss); updated .pre-commit-config.yaml and the GitHub Actions lint workflow; regenerated poetry.lock; ran ruff check --fix and ruff format, then worked through every surfaced violation by hand (raise...from additions, timeouts on bare requests calls, a mutable-default-arg fix, a genuine dead-code removal in rca/utils/shorthand.py, RUF005 list-concatenation rewrites with embedded comments) with noqa comments or project-level ignores for the rest, each with a one-line reason recorded in the MR. One pre-existing, unrelated test failure (rca/schools/tests/test_models.py::test_school_page_404s) confirmed present on the unmigrated baseline too — out of scope. Full test suite (289 tests), ruff check, ruff format --check, manage.py check, and makemigrations --check all pass in Docker. Self-review surfaced and fixed the dropped isort grouping before push. One S308 mark_safe() site (rca/enquire_to_study/views.py) flagged in the MR's "Security findings" section for engineer review, deliberately not silently fixed or suppressed. CI independently confirmed green (lint-front-end, lint-python, test/python-tests all pass at head ea3b297102694df68723834d5a24146e9a9a0186; deploy_staging/deploy_production correctly skip off a Draft PR branch).
